lines.3: 「You're international when it comes to food, at least.」
lines.4: 「Otome is certainly energetic in the mornings.」
lines.6: 「You live with her, so you should know what she--」
lines.8: I drove a hook into Crab's stomach.
lines.11: 「It's a foreign style of friendly horseplay. Very popular right now.」
lines.12: 「What a remarkably violent country. Well, I will go on ahead.」
lines.14: 「Don't punch a lady in the liver! That hurt!」
lines.15: 「Otome living with me is a secret.」
lines.17: 「Fine by me. It's all up to you, Leo. Show a crab some heart, and the water will return it, right?」
lines.18: Crab tugged open the sleeve beneath her arm.
lines.19: Damn... She was going to use this to shake me down.
